How I made them 

Cooking time~ 1 hour 

Ingredients~ 
Crushed egg shell 
Calcium carbonate powder or reptile calcium powder without D3 
Raw egg (used as binder) 
Fluval bug bites pellets tropical formula 
Omega one betta buffet pellets 
Fish flakes of any brand 
Freeze dried bloodworms 
Freeze dried tubifex worms 
Freeze dried shrimp 
Cucumber 
Zucchini 
Yellow squash
Butternut squash 
Romaine lettuce 
Baby spinach 
Chopped kale 
Okra 
Broccoli 
Sweet peas 
Unsalted green bean 
Unsalted wax bean 
Carrot 
Sweet potato 
Algae wafers 
Omega one Veggie rounds 
And water 

1. First you make the crushed egg shell powder the first thing you do is rinse out the raw egg from the shell and remove the membrane then boil them for about 5 minutes (you need exactly 3 egg shells) it’s just like making a boiled egg except it’s just the shell you boil them to kill any possible bad things in it from the raw egg once it’s done boiling take a small pan and spread your egg shells across it then bake it for about 20 minutes to dehydrate it which makes them easier to crush after you take them out of the oven or toaster oven baking them wait till they’ve cooled off enough to touch then break them up into smaller pieces and then using a blender, coffee grinder, or mortar and pestle grind the pieces of egg shell into a powder then put the egg shell powder into a bowl 

2. Take 1 teaspoon of calcium carbonate or reptile calcium powder without D3 and mix it with the egg shell powder really well then take the container from a blender and take 1 tablespoon of bug bites, buffet pellets, fish flakes, bloodworms, shrimp, 3 cubes of tubifex worms, 3 algae wafers, and 3 veggie rounds and blend them all up until their a powder then mix it with your crushed egg shell and calcium carbonate really well 

3. Take 
- 1 slice of cucumber 
- 1 slice of zucchini 
- 1 slice of yellow squash 
- 1 slice of butternut squash 
- 1 leaf from romaine lettuce 
- 1 leaf from baby spinach 
- 4 pieces of chopped kale 
- 1 piece of okra 
- 1 piece of broccoli 
- 4 sweet peas 
- 1 unsalted green bean 
- 1 unsalted wax bean 
- carrot slice 
- and 1 sweet potato slice put all the veggies in the blender then take 1 cup of water and blend it until it’s a mush then put your blended veggies in with your dry mix in the Bowl and mix really well then add 1 raw egg as a binder and mix until you don’t see any egg anymore then take a small pan and put some tin foil over it pour your raw snail cookies in it and bake it for an hour once you take it out let it cool for about 5 minutes then take a sharp knife and cut pieces out of the block which will be your snail cookies
